articles.summary: Originally published on PR Newswire. Cambridge, MA – June 18, 2025 – Biobot Analytics, the leader in wastewater intelligence, today announced a new round of funding led by Valor Equity Partners. Alongside Valor, Biobot is also welcoming new investor Atreides Management, as well as participation from existing investors, including Hyperplane. The investment reflects strong ongoing support […]
articles.title: Biobot Analytics Announces New Funding Round Led by Valor Equity Partners; Expands Board of Directors
